text: DRIP1 completed institutional reforms by 2023, establishing a pathway for city parametric insurance with 145 eligible cities and 17 initial pilots. DRIP2 provides US$500 million for rapid response and reform deepening, addressing macroeconomic risks with average annual losses of ~US$857 million from earthquakes and ~US$2.6 billion from tropical cyclones.
